card.name: Russian Cyrillic text in parentheses
card.fires_on: Cyrillic word pieces in a Russian-language name or phrase given in parentheses after '(Russian:' in an English Wikipedia-style passage. It fires on the first letters and on later pieces of these words.

modes.label: Start of Russian gloss
modes.description: The first letter or piece of the Russian text right after '(Russian:'.

modes.label: Inside Russian words
modes.description: Later pieces of long Cyrillic words within the same parenthetical.
modes.example: Russian: конструкторское бюро Харьковского завода транспортного машиностроения №75 им. Мал<<ыш>>ева) by engineers coming back from N

card.writes: It promotes Cyrillic word endings such as 'ическ' and some Polish pieces, and suppresses Russian first names and Japanese tokens.
card.plain: It fires on Russian-script spellings of names that an English article gives in brackets.
